intent: Record the development-order policy and the fundamentals-first principle in agent instructions so every session proposes work in the right order without user reminders.

requirements.REQ-PH-A: Agent instructions state that the designed feature set is completed and stabilized before any field trial or benchmark, and that a trial is expected to generate its own failure list as evidence for the next cycle.
requirements.REQ-PH-B: Agent instructions state that the harness core stays language-neutral and that language tooling enters as pluggable adapters rather than core structure.
